ambiguities.text: The specification does not define how conflicts between different RIPs using the same transaction type in the reserved range should be resolved
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the RIP process has its own governance for allocating transaction types within the 0x40-0x7f range, similar to how EIPs allocate types in other ranges

ambiguities.text: The boundary behavior at 0x40 and 0x7f is stated as 'inclusive of both' but edge case handling is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard inclusive range check: type >= 0x40 AND type <= 0x7f

implicit_assumptions.description: The RIP governance process will responsibly allocate transaction types within the reserved range
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Multiple L2s could define conflicting transaction types, causing interoperability issues

implicit_assumptions.description: The 64-value range (0x40-0x7f) is sufficient for all future L2 transaction type needs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Range exhaustion could require protocol changes to expand the RIP namespace

implicit_assumptions.description: L1 nodes will not attempt to process RIP transaction types as if they were EIP types
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Invalid transaction processing or node crashes when encountering RIP transactions
